summary: This joint resolution commemorates October 2025 as Head Start Awareness Month, recognizing the program's 60-year history and its positive impact on over 40 million children and their families.

scores.thoughts: This joint resolution commemorates Head Start Awareness Month and recognizes the program's positive impact on children's education and development. While it highlights the benefits of Head Start, it does not propose any changes to funding or policy, thus having no direct impact on spending on public schools.
